findings.claim: A parameter-free finite-pulse diffusion shape provides useful calibrated late-relaxation forecasts within this half-cell campaign.
findings.variables: T: preceding pulse duration(s); a,b: actual calibration times≤60,120s; U_a,U_b: measured voltages(V).
findings.evidence: Reserved96whole blocks/384targets: MAE0.686mV versus persistence3.444mV, fixedRC2.180mV and flexible0.782mV.
findings.known_prior_art: Finite-duration diffusion relaxation is established; novelty is not claimed for its equation.
findings.falsification: Flexible control has lower RMSE and worst-block error. Diagnostic fractional-tail and storage-gain models have lower confirmation MAE but were not development-selected.
findings.scope: One Li-graphite half-cell, same GITT protocol, explicit two-point calibration.

findings.claim: The extra fitted RC channel is not supported as a useful transferable contribution in the60–120s calibrated task.
findings.equation: Weighted diffusion-plus-exponential relaxation reduces to the diffusion-only prediction.
findings.evidence: Attempt4 grouped development error equals attempt1 to numericalprecision; its extra parameters provide no matched gain.
findings.known_prior_art: RC and diffusion components both occur in electrochemical relaxation.
findings.falsification: This does not rule out faster charge-transfer dynamics before the permitted calibration window.
findings.scope: Predictive identifiability under this window and this cell, not absence of electrochemical RC physics.

findings.claim: This calibrated diffusion forecast identifies a unique microscopic diffusivity or provides a uniform industrial error guarantee.
findings.evidence: Unknown geometry/thermodynamic factors cancel from the normalized forecast; no unique D is estimated. Worst held-out block MAE14.49mV.
findings.known_prior_art: Forecast shape and material transport coefficients are distinct inferential targets.
findings.falsification: Single-cell evidence and large tail error contradict an unqualified guarantee.
findings.scope: No independent cells or tolerance specification.

scientific_adjudication: Agent-assisted analysis; not independent experimental replication or human expert adjudication.
